name: Changes
title: Changes: this Rouh's own code, its undo points, and the protected core that checks every change

permissions: asks the protected core beside this Rouh for its undo points and their state, over its socket
puts this Rouh's code back to an undo point when an administrator presses Put back
reads changes a run proposes from the shared folder /run/one/proposals into this Rouh's code, and asks the protected core to check them
jobs: the look for proposed changes and the doctor's word, every 10 seconds where a protected core is beside this Rouh (codechanges.Watch)
touches.remove: Delete rouh/codechanges.py, rouh/web/changes.py, changespage.js/.css, the changes section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, its two routes in rouh/project/urls.py, code_changes in rouh/runtime.py, its entry in app/runs.js and globals.d.ts, and this manifest. The protected core keeps its undo points either way.
